findingDetails.case: A caller passes a misspelled runtime and an empty session id; the envelope says the locator is unavailable and the runtime typo is never surfaced.
findingDetails.scopeProof: index.mjs:97-105 is the only dispatch entry; both readSession and loadSession funnel through it, and neither pre-validates runtime.
findingDetails.title: Unknown runtime is reported as a missing locator, not a gated capability

findingDetails.case: A store file reachable through a link is accepted by containment and then re-opened by its link name, so the reported storePath can differ from the file actually read.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n 'storePath = containment.path' returns exactly claude.mjs, devin.mjs and dsh.mjs; pi.mjs:246-256 already reads the guard's resolved path.
findingDetails.title: Containment is proven on the resolved path while the bytes are opened from the caller's path

findingDetails.case: A user/message event whose data has role and content but no source produces zero records and one injected entry.
findingDetails.scopeProof: dsh.mjs:195-207 is the only user-record branch and dsh.mjs:244-256 the only injected branch; injected-text.test.mjs:174-206 never exercises an absent source.
findingDetails.title: A DSH operator message with no source object is silently reclassified as injected

findingDetails.case: A Devin install whose sessions.db is truncated or locked returns store_unreadable although transcripts/<sessionId>.json on the same machine is intact.
findingDetails.scopeProof: devin.mjs:395-447 is the whole loader tail; every catch on that path returns instead of falling through to loadTranscript at :447.
findingDetails.title: A corrupt Devin sessions.db suppresses the transcript fallback

findingDetails.case: A recommendation with needsMode true, no command, and a skill that has a generated row renders as a runnable command instead of a needs-a-mode head.
findingDetails.scopeProof: render.ts:226 is the only place row?.command backfills a recommendation; command-attach.ts:66-100 keys rows by command-* ids, so no needsMode hub skill currently resolves one.
findingDetails.title: needsMode withholding is defeated when the skill also has a generated command row

searchLedger.invariant: A transcript outside the store is never read.
searchLedger.rationale: Refusal happens before the open, so an out-of-store path never reaches the read.

searchLedger.invariant: A chain with a cycle or missing parent never produces a partial conversation.
searchLedger.rationale: Both walks refuse rather than truncate.
